arithmetic.secular_precision_scope: scalar singular-coordinate filtering, secular norms/bracketing, and diagonal KKT arithmetic
arithmetic.PDE_residual_and_Jacobian_arithmetic: unchanged historical binary64; this utility does not recompute or promote PDE arrays

trust_subproblem.scope: Finite-precision convex quadratic trust-subproblem solution; no nonlinear or interval certificate

origin.limitation: order refinement and direct overlap checks are numerical truncation diagnostics; no rigorous continuous remainder enclosure is asserted

origin_independent_overlap.scope: Independent Cartesian full-potential evaluation at an origin overlap point; no continuous Taylor remainder certificate.

infinity_envelope.integral_upper_bound_arithmetic: Conservative analytic formula evaluated in binary64; no outward rounding certificate.
derivation: |Im(z^n)/Im(z)| <= n on |z|<=1; its y-derivative divided by y is bounded by n(n-1)(n-2)/3.
Legendre d_t^h P_n(2t-1) <= (n+h)!/[h!(n-h)!] on 0<=t<=1, with campaign normalization retained.
s=log(1+r^2) derivatives use Stirling coefficients and u<=1/(1+R^2).
Local Hermite-polynomial Gaussian tails use monomial suprema at z=max(z_lower,sqrt(power),0).
Integrate each positive cross term in dlog(r), multiply angular interval pi/2, and divide by pi*a_ref^2.

independent_integral.limitation: Origin and quadrature errors are order/refinement estimates; infinity envelope uses non-outward-rounded binary64. This is not a uniform trust-neighborhood certificate.
